source.name: Japanese Wiktionary character readings, extracted by Kaikki/Wiktextract

license.attribution: Japanese Wiktionary contributors; structured extraction by Kaikki/Wiktextract; filtered and normalized by precise-furigana.

modifications: Select Japanese-language single-ideograph entries and explicit transliteration forms tagged on or kun.
Exclude untyped, historical, nanori, and marked okurigana or affix forms.
Preserve original forms and tags; normalize on readings to katakana and kun readings to hiragana.
Deduplicate identical records and sort deterministically. Do not infer phonological changes or new readings.
